verdict.rationale: The published pages describe SOSPortal as an account-based platform, with multi-factor authentication, saved drafts and a My Submissions page, and the pack characterizes access as account-based and pay-per-query. Nothing documents a guest, keyless or file-number entry path into the core filing flow. Downloadable PDF forms and the standalone certificate-verification service are adjacent features, not account-free online filing, so they earn no credit.
